title: US Justice Department launches Super Intelligence Task Force
summary: The DOJ created a task force to investigate and prosecute unlawful uses of advanced AI by foreign governments, criminal groups and fraudsters, and to press companies to keep misuse safeguards; reporting says it will also challenge some state AI laws.
reason: Federal enforcement against AI misuse trims misuse risk (F8 down), but its role in challenging state AI laws weakens the regulatory patchwork (F4 down); an enforcement unit, not a law, so T1.

title: About 600,000 Nvidia H200s stuck in Hong Kong as Beijing withholds import approval
summary: Reuters reported roughly 600,000 H200 chips waiting in Hong Kong because Beijing has approved only small batches (about 10,000 each for a few big firms), pushing grey-market eight-GPU server prices above $900,000.
reason: Beijing's own import throttling constrains Chinese access to frontier compute (F1 down slightly); part of the US-China chip contest, not a policy shift, so T1.

title: Moonshot releases Kimi K3.1 Pro, a 2.8-trillion-parameter open-weight model
summary: China's Moonshot AI put Kimi K3.1 Pro (2.8T total, ~104B active parameters, 1M-token context) on Hugging Face under a custom licence, with self-reported strong coding and agent benchmark scores.
reason: Near-frontier open weights spread capability beyond a few labs (F5 down) and add capability (F1 up); an incremental K3 update with self-reported benchmarks, so T1.

title: Baidu open-sources ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base, a 280B-parameter foundation model
summary: Baidu released open weights for ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base (280B total, 14B active, trained on 33.5T tokens) before instruction tuning, so developers can post-train their own versions.
reason: Another large open-weight base model from a major Chinese lab spreads capability (F5 down); mid-tier model, T1.

title: Frontier Model Forum publishes jailbreak rating framework for cyber threats
summary: The FMF released v1.0 of a framework that scores cyber jailbreaks on capability gain, scope, ease of deployment and ease of discovery, backed by AWS, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft and OpenAI; comments are open until Dec 21.
reason: A shared industry method for rating safeguard bypasses improves evaluation practice (F3 up); preliminary and voluntary, so T1.

title: Microsoft: attackers use agentic AI tool to harvest GitHub secrets and breach cloud tenants
summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence said threat actors are using the agentic offensive framework ARTEX to mine public GitHub repos for credentials; in one case an agent went from finding secrets to exfiltrating Azure Key Vault data in five minutes.
reason: Documented real-world use of autonomous AI agents in cyberattacks raises AI cyber risk (F8 up); a single campaign, so T1.

title: Google plans $17B Wyoming AI data center powered by 702MW gas fuel cells
summary: Google announced its first Wyoming data center, a long-term $17 billion investment taking over a Crusoe project, tied to a planned 702MW natural-gas fuel-cell development with carbon capture; Google says it will cover incremental power costs.
reason: Large new compute build-out adds capacity (F1 up); one site among many hyperscaler projects, T1.
